name: Johnny "The Sidewinder" Missle
notes: Known from one interview posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy under his own name (msg_id 1MqH-vnrcWQJ, 27 February 1996), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/an-uncensored-interview-with-johnny-the-sidewinder-missle-1996-02-27.html. The WIWF (1995) and CFWF tenures are his own account in that interview, dated by the post; he also names a PCW and a GFWA stint, but more than one held federation answers to each name, so neither is claimed.
caption: A newcomer interviewed in a February 1996 post about a run through the WIWF, the PCW, the GFWA and the CFWF, from a three-match start in the WIWF to a lost CFWF North American Title.
